evidence: Source review for removal of obsolete goal conversations. Native build 1 remains compatible for supported Chief, Manager and Ticket conversations. The removed legacy_conversation_id field has no Swift consumer. Goal responses retain their other fields. ReviewModels decodes ownerKind as String and accepts the remaining owner kinds. The server no longer emits goal-owned navigation or review addresses. Swift retains a dormant goal ConversationOwner case and a currentConversation lookup for that case, but no other Swift constructor creates it. A cached obsolete goal review item can no longer address a goal conversation, as intended by this removal. Native notification destinations already support only review, ticket, Manager and Chief. Notification settings use generic subject lists. Conversation snapshots, sends to supported owners, reconnect protocol, build gate, and minimum build 1 remain unchanged. Focused browser and retained live-database snapshot checks prove Manager first-message delivery, retained Wren rows, navigation rebuild, notifications and history without errors. This is source compatibility review only. No signed-device, TestFlight, native draft survival or reconnect checks ran.
